Subject: Sizing + GPU options for Dedicated pool — FinTechX use cases

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We walked away excited about Redwood Dedicated but need help narrowing the GPU mix for our reserved pool. High level:

- Three production workloads:
  1) Customer-facing chat (low latency, steady QPS, 1.5k tokens/session avg)
  2) Nightly embeddings job (large batch throughput, 4096-length contexts)
  3) Daily summarization pipeline (mixed latency, variable length)

We’re evaluating A100-80GB, H100-80GB and L40S as possible pool choices. Key asks: throughput guarantees (tokens/sec), memory/capacity tradeoffs (for 4k contexts), and perf/$ at expected commits. Also need an example commit profile (monthly GPU-hours or $) and what discount banding looks like.

Our procurement lead is CC’d. We’re aiming to finalize sizing + pricing by the end of next week so we can submit an internal capex request.

Thanks,
Beth

Subject: Re: Sizing + GPU options for Dedicated pool — FinTechX use cases

Hi Beth — thanks for the clear breakdown. I drafted two concrete configuration proposals and included a short perf/$ comparison in the attached PDF. Summary below (high-level numbers are conservative estimates from our lab and production telemetry):

Option A — Latency-first (H100-heavy):
- Pool: 8 x H100-80GB equivalent (can be physical H100 or split H100+vGPU mix)
- Target: ~1.2M tokens/min sustained across the pool for short-chat workloads, p95 latency target 120–200ms depending on model selection
- Memory: comfortably handles 4k contexts on the models we recommend
- Perf/$: baseline perf is ~1.6–1.9x vs A100 for transformer-decoder generative workloads; cost is ~2.0x per-GPU compared to baseline A100 80GB pricing (depends on region)
- Good for: chat + summarization where latency matters

Option B — Mixed throughput-optimized (A100 + L40S blend):
- Pool: 4 x A100-80GB + 6 x L40S (balanced scheduling)
- Target: higher batch throughput for nightly embeddings; expected 20–30% lower unit cost for large-batch jobs vs H100-only pool
- Memory: A100s handle the largest context jobs; L40S used for stateless, lower-memory inference where perf/$ is stronger
- Perf/$: blended perf yields ~1.1x of A100-only for mixed workloads but noticeably cheaper than H100-only for batch throughput
- Good for: heavy nightly throughput with moderate latency requirements

Commit & discount examples (monthly committed spend):
- $75k/month commit: standard reserved pricing (no extra term discount)
- $150k/month commit: ~12% discount (12-month term)
- $300k/month commit: ~18% discount plus reserved capacity priority (SLA-backed queuing and burst buffer)

Throughput guarantees: we provide token-per-minute SLOs per route. For Dedicated pools we commit to 99.9% availability of the GPU capacity and will provide credits for sustained breaches. Exact guarantees depend on commit size and model family — I included contingency values in the PDF.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf (contains model-specific perf curves, sample scheduling policy, and estimated monthly GPU-hour usage for the above options).

If you want, we can size a 2-week POC: we can put a small alpha pool (2 H100 + 2 L40S) and run your test prompts to capture real perf/$ and token latency profiles.

Next steps: if Option A or B looks close, tell me preferred commit range and target term (12 vs 24 months) and I’ll route to Commercial for a pricing sheet and a draft MSA.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Sizing + GPU options for Dedicated pool — FinTechX use cases

Jonas / team —

Nice write-up. A couple of negotiation notes before we surface a formal commercial sheet:

1) Financing bands: Procurement will push for a single blended price if we present a mixed pool. Propose a "blended-GPU unit" metric (effective GPU-hour) so we can offer a clean $/GPU-hr rather than listing component SKUs.

2) Intro incentive: offer a "first-quarter" usage credit equal to 5–10% of committed spend to lower their ramp risk. This is often the decider for platform teams.

3) Discount floors: recommend these public ranges for Commercial to accept: 10–14% @ $150k, 16–20% @ $300k, 22–26% @ $500k (12mo term). 24mo terms should get an additional 4–6% only if they give a higher upfront payment.

4) SLOs / credits: ensure Credit calc uses token velocity and not just uptime; include an explicit API fallthrough to smaller hosted model in case of capacity pressure so they can maintain user-facing latency during incidents.

I can handle the pricing call if Procurement asks for a firm counter — want to keep Commercial velocity but preserve margin. Looping in Rishi for quant guidance.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Engineering
redwood.ai

Jonas / Marissa,

Appreciate the clear options. A few clarifying items from our side:

- We prefer a single pool (less operational overhead). Latency for chat matters most — we’re inclined toward H100.
- Cost overruns are the primary internal blocker. If you can show a blended $/GPU-hr for a mixed pool that is within 12% of the H100-only perf (for chat) we’d probably pick the mixed option.
- POC: yes please — 2-week POC that runs our top 10 production prompts and the nightly embedding job. Will need simple contract language for a short trial and evidence of data isolation for embeddings.
- Can you provide a migration runbook and an estimate for engineering lift (FTE weeks) to move models from our current on-prem infra to the Redwood Dedicated pool?

Procurement: we’ll want the pricing sheet and draft MSA in the next 5 business days to start the internal approval.

Best,
Beth

Beth / team —

Thanks — good guidance. Based on your single-pool preference and the perf/$ target, I’m proposing two final lanes we can present to Procurement today:

Lane 1 — H100-focused (simpler ops, higher latency SLAs):
- Config: 8 x H100-80GB equivalent
- Commit: $310k/month (12mo)
- Discount: 18% applied to list; first-quarter usage credit = 7% of committed spend
- SLA: 99.9% capacity availability; throughput SLO: 1.15M tokens/min sustained (chat profile)
- Migration estimate: ~3–4 FTE-weeks (data transfer + validation + CI updates)

Lane 2 — Blended H100+L40S (cost-efficient; meets perf target):
- Config: 6 x H100-80GB + 4 x L40S (scheduling policy biases chat to H100)
- Commit: $265k/month (12mo)
- Discount: 21% applied to list (blended), first-quarter usage credit = 10%
- SLA: same availability; blended throughput SLO: ~1.05M tokens/min (meets your "within 12%" perf target)
- Migration estimate: ~4–5 FTE-weeks (slightly more testing because of mixed scheduling rules)

Attachments: pricing-sheet-ftx-20261122.xlsx (line-item pricing, blended GPU-hour metric, commercial terms), slo-dedicated-99.9.pdf (SLO and credit calculation). I’ve also included a short migration runbook excerpt in the spreadsheet.

POC: we’ll stand up a 2-week POC environment within 3 business days of a signed trial addendum. I can share the trial addendum template for Procurement to review now — DocuSign link attached: https://www.docusign.com/FTX-RW-20261122

If Procurement is comfortable with Lane 2, I’ll coordinate with Commercial to issue a draft MSA and get it to you for redlines. Marissa — happy if you want to lead the pricing conversation with Procurement.

Next steps: confirm lane preference and I’ll schedule a 30-min procurement walkthrough.
